title: I'm really sorry
greeting: Abe sun be, ek baar padh ke dekh.
paragraphs: Maine jo bhi tere saath bahut pehle mazaak kiye ya kuch bola, uske liye agar tu offend ya hurt hui hai toh sorry.
Btw bata doon, jaisa tu sochti hai, main waisa nahi hoon.

Rahi baat Krishna ki, toh maana ki maine password guess kiya tha, jo ki tere naam se tha, aur woh correct nikla. But account mein kuch nahi tha, bas tere saath simple chat thi. Last mein kuch aisa tha ki tum dono ki zyada baat nahi hui thi aur phir usne tujhse breakup kar liya tha. Uske baad kuch nahi tha.
Aur tune apni jo images bheji thi, Snapchat ke filters wali, bas wohi thi.
Aur haan, tujhe lagta hai ki maine mazaak kiya hai, toh woh main nahi hoon, theek hai. Baaki teri marzi.
Btw, happy birthday toh ek friend ki tarah keh hi sakta hoon. Happy birthday 💜
